description_en: Calls the CreateHybridMonitorNamespace operation to create a metric repository
description_zh: 调用CreateHybridMonitorNamespace接口创建指标仓库
name: CreateHybridMonitorNamespace

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric repository.

Format: consists of lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
指标仓库名称。

格式：由小写字母、数字和短划线（-）组成
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The description of the metric repository
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The data storage duration. Valid values:

cms.s1.large: storage duration of 15 days.
cms.s1.xlarge: storage duration of 32 days.
cms.s1.2xlarge: storage duration of 63 days.
cms.s1.3xlarge (default): storage duration of 93 days.
cms.s1.6xlarge: storage duration of 185 days.
cms.s1.12xlarge: storage duration of 376 days.

For the pricing of different storage duration specifications, see the Pricing section in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223532.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据存储时长。取值：

cms.s1.large：数据存储时长15天。
cms.s1.xlarge：数据存储时长32天。
cms.s1.2xlarge：数据存储时长63天。
cms.s1.3xlarge（默认值）：数据存储时长93天。
cms.s1.6xlarge：数据存储时长185天。
cms.s1.12xlarge：数据存储时长376天。

不同存储时长规格的价格，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223532.html中的**价格表**
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en:
The storage solution for monitoring data. Valid values:

aliyun_prometheus: monitoring data is stored in Managed Service for Prometheus.

For more information about storage solutions for monitoring data, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2594921.html
parameters.help_zh:
监控数据的存储方案。取值：

aliyun_prometheus：监控数据存储在 Prometheus 服务中。

关于监控数据的存储方案的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2594921.html
parameters.name: namespace_type

parameters.help_en: The region in which monitoring data is stored
parameters.name: namespace_region

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败
